title: Names used by batch p3-G02-2 (keyless IP geolocation votes, IPQualityScore, ZoomEye, IPGuardian/NetAPI, NetworksDB)

attributes.geo_votes: approximate network geolocation of an IP voted by independent keyless providers {line, country, country_votes ('BR - 2/2 providers'), asn, asn_votes, isp, city ('<city> - approximate (<provider>)' with disagreements), approximate, providers, could_not_verify}: context only, never a person's location or a risk factor
attributes.ipqs_ip: IPQualityScore IP reputation facts {fraud_score (0-100), vote (suspicious | no_signal), recent_abuse, abuse_velocity, connection_type, proxy, vpn, tor, bot_status, isp, asn}: one vote, never 'malicious' on its own
attributes.ipqs_url: IPQualityScore URL scanner facts {risk_score (0-100), vote, unsafe, phishing, malware, suspicious, category, domain_age, redirected, final_url}: one vote, never 'malicious' on its own
attributes.zoomeye_assets: ZoomEye asset rows for an IOC selector (capped): list of {ip, port, service, product, title, domain, update_time, honeypot} plus the total the search reported
attributes.ipguardian_lists: public blocklists IPGuardian reports for the IP after deduplication against the local P149 feeds {new_lists, covered_by_p149, context_lists, ignored_lists, network_type}
attributes.netapi_compromised: NetAPI compromised-feed state of the value {listed_now, listed_ever, first_seen, last_seen, threat_type, evidence, via (local feed | check API), feed}: one vote at most, sinkhole rows are context

relations.candidate_netblock: company name or IP -> CIDR a fuzzy registry search (NetworksDB) attributes to the organisation: candidate only (expand=False, confidence <= 0.4) until RDAP (P003) or NIC.br (P038) confirm it; never an ACTIVE scope by itself
